excerpt_i18n.en:
The 2025 Tmall Double 11 sale will officially begin at 8 PM on October 20. On October 16, it was learned from the Tmall Double 11 press conference that this marks the 17th Tmall Double 11, the first Double 11 in the era of mass consumption, the first with comprehensive AI implementation, and the first with full participation from Taobao Flash Sales. 

Jialuo, President of Tmall, stated that with the convergence of AI and mass consumption as two major historical opportunities, Tmall is investing heavily in AI to upgrade product capabilities, combining algorithms with significant investments in core users, supporting high-quality brands in enhancing their offerings, making brand operations more efficient, users more engaged, and shopping experiences more immediate, ushering in a golden era of efficient growth for brands. 

As the biggest annual growth opportunity for brands, Tmall Double 11 is increasingly indispensable and crucial for brand growth. In the new context of AI and mass consumption, Tmall Double 11 will open up fresh historical growth opportunities for brands, Jialuo added.

Presale data for Tmall Double 11 shows that in the first hour, 35 brands surpassed 100 million yuan in transactions, and 1,802 brands doubled their transaction volumes, with the numbers of billion-yuan brands, doubling brands, and active users all exceeding those of the same period last year.

This year, Tmall has invested heavily in AI research and development, providing brands with new opportunities for leapfrog development. The platform's computing power has increased 40-fold, and the perception of user behavior sequences has extended from six months to ten years, significantly improving the accuracy of product recommendations and boosting purchasing efficiency by 25%.

Throughout this year's Double 11 period, Tmall will distribute 50 billion yuan in consumer vouchers to subsidize users, with some vouchers allocated by the AI "Smart Benefit Engine" for unified decision-making, as part of a pilot initiative.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 20 de octubre a las 20:00 horas comenzará oficialmente el Tmall Double 11 de 2025. El 16 de octubre, según se supo en la conferencia de prensa del evento, esta será la decimoséptima edición del Tmall Double 11, la primera en la era del gran consumo, la primera con implementación integral de IA y la primera con participación completa de las ofertas flash de Taobao. El presidente de Tmall, Jialuo, afirmó que la convergencia de la IA y el gran consumo representa dos oportunidades históricas, por lo que Tmall está apostando e invirtiendo en mejorar las capacidades de los productos mediante IA, combinando algoritmos con fuertes inversiones en usuarios clave, apoyando a marcas de calidad en su mejora y haciendo que la gestión de las marcas sea más eficiente, los usuarios más activos y la experiencia de compra más inmediata, inaugurando así una era dorada de crecimiento eficiente para las marcas como la mayor oportunidad de crecimiento anual.

The integration of AI, XR, and advanced connectivity technologies is creating unprecedented possibilities for cross-device, personalized spatial computing experiences. Qualcomm is promoting the fusion of AI and XR technologies, developing a comprehensive product roadmap for XR devices such as VR, MR, and AR. Leveraging the leading technology of the Snapdragon XR platform, robust ecosystem support, and extensive device deployment, Qualcomm provides comprehensive support to Chinese manufacturer partners, jointly driving continuous innovation in XR devices and application experiences to unlock more possibilities for the future of the metaverse. excerpt_i18n.en:
In the new era of accelerating integration between edge intelligence and generative AI, AI terminal devices equipped with powerful local computing capabilities are becoming key drivers of technological transformation and application innovation. From content creation and productivity tools to smart assistants and industry solutions, AI is increasingly operating through a coordinated "cloud" and "edge" approach, reshaping human-computer interaction and production processes with lower latency and higher efficiency.

To further stimulate AI innovation at the edge and promote deep integration of generative AI with edge intelligence, the "2025 Snapdragon AI Innovation Application Competition," hosted by Qualcomm Wireless Semiconductor Technologies Ltd., organized by Extreme Vision, with technical support from Thundercomm and product partnerships from Acer, Honor, Red Magic, and OPPO, officially launched on October 14. The competition focuses on two main platforms—AI PCs and smartphones/tablets—leveraging advanced CPU, GPU, and NPU capabilities, the robust Qualcomm® AI Stack, and AI inference software frameworks. It invites global developers to submit innovative and practical AI applications, exploring the limitless possibilities of AI in enhancing future life.

The "2025 Snapdragon AI Innovation Application Competition" features two main tracks—AI PC and smartphone/tablet—with a total of four challenges, covering a wide range of scenarios from high-performance computing to mobile portability, providing a platform for creative applications to flourish. The AI PC track focuses on the next generation.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la nueva era de la fusión acelerada entre la inteligencia en el dispositivo y la IA generativa, los dispositivos terminales de IA con potente capacidad de procesamiento local se están convirtiendo en una fuerza clave que impulsa la transformación tecnológica y la innovación aplicada. Desde la creación de contenido y las herramientas de productividad hasta los asistentes inteligentes y las soluciones sectoriales, la IA ha formado gradualmente una operación coordinada entre la "nube" y el "terminal", remodelando la interacción humano-máquina y los procesos productivos con menor latencia y mayor eficiencia. Para estimular aún más el potencial innovador de la IA en el terminal y promover la integración profunda de la IA generativa con la inteligencia en el dispositivo, el evento está organizado por Qualcomm Wireless Semiconductor Technologies, Ltd., gestionado por Extreme Vision, con soporte técnico de Thundercomm, y la participación de socios de productos como Acer, Honor, Red Magic y OPPO.
